abilities.title: Damage by ability
abilities.description: Per preset and ability (pets included): DPS, share of damage, casts, hits, crits, ticks, average hit and crit, misses, dodges and glances per fight.

auras.title: Buff and debuff uptime
auras.description: Per preset, the average share of the fight each aura is up on the player or the boss, and how often it is applied.

builds.title: Presets and headline DPS
builds.description: One row per level 60 preset: mean DPS over 20,000 simulated 180 s fights against the generic boss, percentiles, best race overall and per faction, and talents. Encounter presets (the boss as one creature type) are extra rows with their creature type and why they are advantaged (in full and in one short line). Duty presets (the preset keeps a raid buff or debuff up itself, with the raid's copy off) are extra rows with the duty, their base preset and the DPS it costs; they get the main run, lengths and race sweep only. Simmed on master baed22e62's class code plus warrior 38b94b40a; most builds ran before per-hit rounding (about 0.007%), see provenance.json.

gear.title: Gear
gear.description: Per preset, the item and enchant in each slot of its synthetic Phase 1 set.

hist.title: Fight-to-fight spread
hist.description: Per preset, how many of the 20,000 fights landed in each 5 DPS bin.

icons.title: Talent and spell icons
icons.description: 36 px class, race, faction and preset icons, and 56 px header icons, as data URLs. The Ranking tab needs only these, so they load first.

icons_more.title: More icons
icons_more.description: 36 px spell, item and aura icons and the sim UI's empty gear-slot icons, as data URLs. They load after the Ranking tab is up.

lengths.title: DPS by fight length
lengths.description: Every preset at 60, 120, 180, 300 and 480 s average fight length, 5,000 fights each.

mana.title: Mana over a long fight
mana.description: Per mana-using preset, its mana as a % of max every 5 s through a 480 s fight with its own consumes and rotation: the average over 100 fights (pct) and the 25th and 75th percentile fight (p25, p75).

mana_summary.title: When mana runs low
mana_summary.description: Per mana-using preset over the same 480 s fights: when mana first drops below 15% of max (median and 25th to 75th percentile fight, empty when most fights never do), the share of fights that ever do, mana % at 60, 180, 300 and 480 s, mana spent and gained per second, and the sim's seconds out of mana, time to OOM and mana left at the end over 5,000 fights.

names.title: Spell and item names
names.description: Names, icons and an icon-derived colour for the spell, item and attack ids in the timelines, breakdowns and rotations.

notes.title: Talents, rotation and caveats
notes.description: Per preset, its key talents, rotation priority, consumes and open questions, plus the gear rules every synthetic set follows (build _round, kind gear).

race_breakdown.title: Race DPS split by racial
race_breakdown.description: Each preset and race split into base stats (every racial off) and what each racial adds, plus the weapon swap and the change against each creature type. Racials turned off one at a time; where two count, each gets the average of its two orders so the parts add up.

race_notes.title: Race scenario notes
race_notes.description: What each race scenario switches on, what each racial does in the sim (with a short line for the tooltips), and a few plain sentences per class written from the race sims.

race_summary.title: Race usefulness
race_summary.description: Per scenario, role and race, across all races or within the race's faction: presets it can play, how often it is the best race, its average and worst gap to the best, its median rank and the presets where it comes closest.

race_variants.title: Race scenarios
race_variants.description: Every preset on every race its class can be: against the generic boss with the preset's own setup, against a Beast or an Elemental boss, against a Humanoid boss (Priests only, for Dwarf Chastise), with the race's racial weapon, and with all racials off. Mean DPS over 10,000 fights at 180 s, its standard error, and the gap to the best race in that scenario.

races.title: Race sweep
races.description: Every preset on every race its class can be: mean DPS over 10,000 fights at 180 s, and the gap to the best race.

rotation.title: Rotation priority lists
rotation.description: Each preset's APL as simmed: pre-pull casts with their timing, then the priority list in order, each line's spell, a plain-English condition, the APL's own note, its exact condition and the spell's casts per fight.

race_rotation.title: Race rotations
race_rotation.description: The races that play their own rotation on a preset: each line lined up with the preset's (the same, changed, added or removed), with why it changed. No cast counts: the race sims record DPS only.

setup.title: Consumes and raid buffs
setup.description: Per preset, the consumes, self buffs, raid and party buffs, boss debuffs and professions in its sim settings, grouped as the sim UI groups them. active says whether the entry changes the preset's result in the sim (each entry left out in turn, same seed: an identical DPS means no effect); why gives the reason when it doesn't, such as a non-stacking pair, a buff the class already provides, or something WoW Forever doesn't have.

stats.title: Character sheets
stats.description: Per preset, final character stats with gear, talents, buffs and consumes.

talenttrees.title: Talent trees
talenttrees.description: Every class talent tree as the sim UI lays it out: each talent’s row, column, ranks, prerequisite, text from ui/core/talents/trees, and the wowhead page of each rank (Forever's database where it has the spell, else Classic's).

timeline_druid.title: Druid sample fights
timeline_druid.description: Three single fights per druid preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

timeline_hunter.title: Hunter sample fights
timeline_hunter.description: Three single fights per hunter preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

timeline_mage.title: Mage sample fights
timeline_mage.description: Three single fights per mage preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

timeline_paladin.title: Paladin sample fights
timeline_paladin.description: Three single fights per paladin preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

timeline_priest.title: Priest sample fights
timeline_priest.description: Three single fights per priest preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

timeline_rogue.title: Rogue sample fights
timeline_rogue.description: Three single fights per rogue preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

timeline_shaman.title: Shaman sample fights
timeline_shaman.description: Three single fights per shaman preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

timeline_warlock.title: Warlock sample fights
timeline_warlock.description: Three single fights per warlock preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

timeline_warrior.title: Warrior sample fights
timeline_warrior.description: Three single fights per warrior preset (nearest its 10th, 50th and 90th percentile): the auras and the pre-pull casts, for the aura bars. The whole fights are in events/<build>.json.gz.

tooltips.title: Game tooltip text
tooltips.description: Tooltip text for the spells, items, enchants, consumes, races and stat weights on the page: wowhead's WoW Forever database first (with a link to its page), the Forever client's talent text and the Forever wiki where it has nothing, Classic's text only as a marked last resort, the sim's own numbers where they differ, the item database for the synthetic gear, and the Forever racials.

treeart.title: Talent tree art
treeart.description: Each class talent tree’s icon and background art (the backgrounds the sim UI uses, from Wowhead), stored as data URLs.

weights.title: Stat weights
weights.description: Per preset, the DPS one more point of each stat adds (per 1% for hit and crit), measured by adding the stat on top of the gear and simming 40,000 fights at 180 s with the baseline’s seed; worth is in points of the preset’s main stat.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: Every value Forever hasn't confirmed that the presets depend on, by class, in plain words: a question-style label, one short line for the panel, a description and its source for Method, the presets it touches, its Low / Expected / High settings (each with a label that says what it means, its numbers and a short rationale), which one the presets use, and each setting's effect on each preset at 180 s.

assumption_dps.title: DPS under each assumption
assumption_dps.description: Per preset an assumption touches: mean DPS with no setting changed, with each other setting alone (180 s at 20,000 fights, 120 and 300 s at 5,000), and with combinations of settings at 180 s (every combination where a preset has 3 or fewer assumptions, 12 random ones otherwise, which check the multiplied estimate the page uses for the rest). Seed 1, the preset's own request.

event_names.title: Event view names
event_names.description: The name, icon and rank of every spell and item in the sample fights and of each preset's weapons, as the sim UI's database and wowhead name them. Made by tools/dps_report/events.py.

event_icons.title: Event view icons
event_icons.description: 36 px icons, as data URLs, that the sample fights show and icons and icons_more lack. Made by tools/dps_report/events.py.

changes.title: Updates
changes.description: The report's updates, newest first: game updates (a new client build or development notes) and sim/preset updates (our own changes to the sim, rotations, gear, talents, consumes or races), each with its date, source and public change list. Each line may name the classes, presets, races and racial parts it touches.

changes_snap.title: Results before and after each update
changes_snap.description: The report's results at the first update's start in full (genesis), then each update's end as only the rows that changed (ends, with gone listing rows that left): builds (DPS, error, ranks, race, best race), races (each preset on each race), parts (each racial part's DPS against the generic boss) and summary (per race and role, how often it is best and its average gap).

tank_builds.title: Tanking presets and scores
tank_builds.description: One row per tanking preset: class, spec, preset kind and its weight (max threat 1/3, balanced 1, max survival 3), race, talents, and the means over the six scored bosses (Magmadar, Golemagg, Onyxia, Broodlord, Vaelastrasz, Chromaggus; Ragnaros is shown but not scored) of the three scores, safe DPS, healing needed, death floor, death chance, TPS, DPS, DTPS and TMI, with standard errors and the rank among presets of the same kind. From tools/tankbench, 1,000 iterations a boss, each req's own seed.

tank_bosses.title: Tanking by boss
tank_bosses.description: Per tanking preset and boss (7 bosses): the three scores, safe DPS, healing needed (and as a multiple of DTPS), death floor, TPS, DPS, DTPS, TMI, death chance, health, effective health, biggest hit, armor, defense and the table (miss, dodge, parry, block, crit, crush). A score the bench reports as "none" (no healing saves the tank) is null with a flag.

tank_encounters.title: Tanking encounters
tank_encounters.description: One row per boss: name, whether it is scored, fight length, the raid's healers and their HPS, and the bench's notes on the encounter and its stand-in healer.

tank_races.title: Tanking by race
tank_races.description: Per tanking preset and every race the class can be: the six-boss mean scores, safe DPS, healing needed, DTPS and TPS, the preset's own race flagged. Each race is the same req with only the race changed.

tank_gear.title: Tanking gear
tank_gear.description: Per tanking preset, every equipped item with its enchant and the reason for the pick, in the DPS gear dataset's shape.

tank_rotation.title: Tanking rotations
tank_rotation.description: Per tanking preset, the APL's steps in the DPS rotation dataset's shape (no cast counts; the bench reports none), with each step's notes.

tank_setup.title: Tanking consumables and buffs
tank_setup.description: Per tanking preset, the consumables, raid buffs and debuffs it is simmed with, in the DPS setup dataset's shape.

tank_tooltips.title: Tanking tooltips
tank_tooltips.description: Item and spell tooltips the tanking pages show that the common tooltips dataset lacks, same row shape.

tank_notes.title: Tanking notes
tank_notes.description: The preset notes and the open calls from the class tanking docs (docs/tank_<class>.md), as simple HTML.

tank_method.title: Tanking method
tank_method.description: The sections of docs/tank_sim.md that explain the method: rulings, encounters, the bench, the stand-in healer, scoring survival and the optimizer's objective, as simple HTML.

tank_icons.title: Tanking icons
tank_icons.description: The icons the tanking pages show that the common icons datasets lack, as data URLs (":l" keys are the large versions).

tank_names.title: Tanking names
tank_names.description: Names, ranks, icons and colors of the spells and items the tanking pages show that the common names dataset lacks.

heal_builds.title: Healing presets and carry
heal_builds.description: One row per healing preset: class, spec, role (tank healer or raid healer), race, talents, and the means over the 7 boss files (Onyxia, Broodlord, Chromaggus, Golemagg, Magmadar, Ragnaros, Vaelastrasz) of carry (damage carried, the score in docs/healing_sim.md), HPS, effective HPS, overheal, effective healing per mana, mana left, OOM time, and tank and other deaths, with the rank within its role. From tools/healbench, 1,000 iterations a file, each file at its own length, seed 101.

heal_bosses.title: Healing by boss
heal_bosses.description: Per healing preset and boss: carry, HPS, effective HPS, overheal, healing per mana, mana left, OOM time, tank and raid DTPS, deaths, first death, scares and death floor.

heal_encounters.title: Healing encounters
heal_encounters.description: One row per boss: name, fight length for the tank and raid files, the raid's healers, their classes and HPS, the tank's healers, and the bench's notes on the damage and the setup.

heal_races.title: Healing by race
heal_races.description: Per healing preset and every race the class can be: mean carry, HPS, effective HPS, overheal, healing per mana and mana left over the 7 files, the preset's own race flagged. Each race is the same req with only the race changed.

heal_gear.title: Healing gear
heal_gear.description: Per healing preset, every equipped item with its enchant, in the DPS gear dataset's shape.

heal_rotation.title: Healing rotations
heal_rotation.description: Per healing preset, the APL's steps in the DPS rotation dataset's shape (no cast counts), with each step's notes.

heal_setup.title: Healing consumables and buffs
heal_setup.description: Per healing preset, the consumables, raid buffs and debuffs it is simmed with, in the DPS setup dataset's shape.

heal_tooltips.title: Healing tooltips
heal_tooltips.description: Item and spell tooltips the healing pages show that the common tooltips dataset lacks, same row shape.

heal_notes.title: Healing notes
heal_notes.description: The preset notes and the open calls from the class healing docs (docs/healing_<class>.md), as simple HTML.

heal_method.title: Healing method
heal_method.description: The sections of docs/healing_sim.md that explain the score, the roles, the damage, who heals whom and the rulings, as simple HTML.

heal_assumptions.title: Healing assumptions
heal_assumptions.description: Values Forever hasn't confirmed that the healing presets depend on, by class, in plain words, with the assumptions dataset's shape: a question-style label, a short answer, a description (what the alternative would cost, measured when the healers were tuned) and its source, the healing presets it touches, and its one setting, the one the presets use. None is simmed.

heal_icons.title: Healing icons
heal_icons.description: The icons the healing pages show that the common icons datasets lack, as data URLs (":l" keys are the large versions).

heal_names.title: Healing names
heal_names.description: Names, ranks, icons and colors of the spells and items the healing pages show that the common names dataset lacks.
